name: Elixir of Suffering
label: Quest
description: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon pursues lethal brews against the living. He turns to travelers for animal reagents from the surrounding foothills.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon pursues lethal brews against the living. He turns to travelers for animal reagents from the surrounding foothills.

Tarren Mill is both a Forsaken stronghold in the Hillsbrad Foothills and a research station for the Royal Apothecary Society. Apothecary Lydon works there amid the green countryside, which he despises. He longs to see human settlements poisoned and conquered. To make his experimental Elixir of Suffering, he needs potent, virulent ingredients from nearby creatures.

Apothecary Lydon sends hunters into the wilds around Tarren Mill for Gray Bear tongues and the rare ichor of Moss Creepers. Unholy alchemy refines these animal substances into the basis of a lethal mixture. He intends it to kill living trespassers across Hillsbrad.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, another wretched day in Tarren Mill. All of this clean air puts me in such a foul mood, friend.
The sooner we can plague the humans here, the better. I've been conducting intense studies on possible killing agents to use in my concoctions but I haven't the time to collect them all.

If you want to make yourself of use, procure the following items for me: 10 Gray Bear Tongues and the very rare and hard to find, Creeper Ichor. You'll find both bears and creepers just outside of Tarren Mill.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I see you are back. I hope you were able to gather the agents I need. Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These specimens are perfect. Well, friend, you have managed to bring me the slightest hint of joy on yet another miserable day. Your efforts are appreciated.
